kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننتحب (form VIII)
# نَنْتَحِبُ (nantaḥibu) /nan.ta.ħi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
# نَنْتَحِبَ (nantaḥiba) /nan.ta.ħi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
# نَنْتَحِبْ (nantaḥib) /nan.ta.ħib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَحَبَ (intaḥaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
